annotations.title: Get RTO registration and regulatory record

description: One Australian Registered Training Organisation (RTO) by RTO code: legal and trading names, ABN, registration status and period, first registration date, regulator (ASQA, VRQA or TAC), head office, websites, every regulatory decision recorded on training.gov.au (conditions, suspensions, cancellations, rejected renewals, with status, dates, review and the original decision text), and the CRICOS schools linked to it on oneuedu.com with their open course counts. Use it to check whether a vocational provider is registered and in good standing. This public endpoint returns English natural-language text, preserving sources, conditions and pagination.

includeDecisionText.description: Include each decision's original text (up to 1,200 characters each). Set false for status and dates only.

locale.description: Language of names/descriptions in the result: zh-CN (default, Simplified Chinese plus English names), en-US, zh-TW. Also selects the language prefix of returned oneuedu.com URLs.

rto.description: RTO code (e.g. "22134"), or a oneuedu.com /rto/<code> or training.gov.au organisation URL.

name: get_rto
title: Get RTO registration and regulatory record
